tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin chen nus pa'i char 'bebs bzhugs so//

༄༅// chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhal yas nas// phyag rgya zil gnon lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas// slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// u rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas// rig 'dzin shrī seng ha la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje can// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// rgya gar dur khrod nag po nas// paṇa chen shintaṃ garbha la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer nas// rgyal po bha su dhā ra la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /bod yul sgrag kyi yangs rdzong nas// gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams nas// gter ston rgya yi zhang khrom la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /lcags gtun nag po chos kyi grags// gnubs ston bya bral mtshan can la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /skal ldan rdo rje rgyal po dang*// dhārma ke tu slob dpon la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /gnubs chen gu ru mchog ldan dang*// mthu chen rgyal mtshan lhun grub la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /sngags 'chang tshe bdag bkra shis dang*// rig 'dzin padma dkar po la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /yongs 'dzin ngag dbang bzang po dang*// rgyal ba dpag bsam dbang po la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /'dren mchog kun dga' lhun grub dang*// chos kyi dbang phyug dge legs zhabs// gsol ba= /bdag la= /zil gnon ye shes rol pa dang*// grub mchog ngag dbang bde chen la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /dpal chen dharma surya dang*// yongs 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /mi pham 'jam dpal rdo rje dang*// las rab bde chen rtsal gyi zhabs// gsol ba= /bdag la= /rig 'dzin chos skyong mgon po dang*// bdud 'joms padma dgyes pa la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /mthu stobs chos kyi rgya mtsho dang*// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba=

/bdag la= / 'dir brgyud rim gyi 'phro'athud/ gzhan yang bka' gter brgyud pa yi// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la// gsol ba= /bdag la= /sngon tshe bsod nams bsags pa yis// bla med theg mchog 'di dang mjal// bde chen ngang nas sku bzhengs la// phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba yis// sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po mchog /'bru brgyad sngags kyi bro chen brdung*// hūm̐/ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir// skye dang 'chi ba bya ba med// 'khor ba ye nas sangs rgyas te// ngan song gsum po lta bas bsgral// rnam rtog gdod nas chos sku yin// snang srid ma bcos phyag rgya'i zhing*// thams cad dregs pa'i lha tshogs la// 'bru brgyad sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul// thams cad grags stong ye shes ste// gsung gi dngos grub chen po stsol// 'di ni ye shes chen po'i bro// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par brdung*// phyag rgya zil gnon mchog gi lam// lam 'di kun gyi thob gyur cig /
